messages:
maria (support): Customer onboards reported SSO failures immediately after IdP rotated signing certs. They see 403 on ACS POSTs and a pile of 'Recipient mismatch' / 'SignatureInvalid' errors. Tenant: acme-co. Can eng-sre take a look? Attached partial logs below.

jordan (eng-sre): Can you paste the exact SAMLResponse error and the ACS URL the RP is expecting? Also did the IdP send both old+new certs in the metadata during rotation?

maria (support): From the customer logs: 
```
ERROR SAML validation failed: RecipientMismatch - incoming Assertion Recipient 'https://app.acme.example/saml/consume' does not match registered ACS 'https://app.acme.example/saml/consume/'
ERROR Signature validation failed: signing certificate thumbprint mismatch (got 3a:5f:... expected 4b:6d:...)
```
Their metadata file uploaded to us shows two <KeyDescriptor> entries (old then new). CW: the ACS registered in our tenant UI is `https://app.acme.example/saml/consume` (no trailing slash). IdP metadata has trailing slash in ACS and includes both keys.

tayla (eng): That trailing slash can cause RecipientMismatch because our normalization is strict. Also ordering of KeyDescriptor sometimes breaks our 'pick first' logic when IdP supplies both old+new during rolling swap. Two things to try: canonicalize ACS (strip trailing slash when matching) and validate signature against any key in metadata chain (not only first). Short-term workaround: ask customer to hit the ACS URL exactly as registered (add/remove trailing slash) or we can update tenant to accept both forms.

sam (solutions): Customer is asking for a step-by-step repro so they can get back online quickly. Quick manual steps: 
1) Fetch IdP metadata (replace METADATA_URL):
```bash
curl -s -o idp.xml "METADATA_URL"
grep -A2 '<AssertionConsumerService' idp.xml
```
2) Confirm KeyDescriptor certs: 
```bash
xmllint --xpath "//ds:X509Certificate/text()" idp.xml | sed -n '1,2p'
```
If you see two certs, we should accept either until rotation completes. Also metadata poller TTL was default 300s; advise bumping to 60s temporarily for the tenant during rotation.

jordan (eng-sre): I dug into the metadata poller. Root cause: when IdP publishes both keys, our poller stores the first KeyDescriptor and uses that thumbprint for signature checks. During rotation the incoming assertion uses the new key but the poller had cached the old first-key ordering. Fix: update poller to merge keys and index by keyId/thumbprint instead of position. I'll push a quick patch to canonicalize ACS URLs (strip trailing slash and normalize percent-encoding) and to try signature verification against any cert in the metadata for 30s grace.

deploy-bot: metadata-poller v2 (hotfix: accept-multi-key + acs-normalize) deployed to prod us-west at 1767010000 :rocket:

maria (support): Deployed patch is live. I asked customer to attempt login now and to provide a SAMLResponse if it still fails.

maria (support): Customer confirmed: login succeeded after ~2 minutes. They hit the ACS without trailing slash and then again with trailing slash and both work now. Marking this resolved on the ticket. :white_check_mark:

jordan (eng-sre): Follow-ups: file a small postmortem and add a normalization check in onboarding docs recommending tenants register ACS both with and without trailing slash (or we perform canonicalization automatically). Also add a note about metadata TTL during certhandovers.

sam (solutions): I'll update the KB and include the curl/xmllint repro steps + temporary poller-TTL advice.

maria (support): Thanks team — closing thread. If customer re-sees anything, we'll reopen.
